answer: A fresh identity starts in a bare meadow with zero history, while honest agents build a proven tundra of past epochs. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond in a shared grove contract before voting, and reputation accrues only from sustained work across distinct tasks. Attackers must fund every fake identity's bond plus months of real output to earn trust, making mass sybils economically ruinous. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
